title: Fixed `ShortcutContext#addShortcut()` placing a `position: 'before'` shortcut one slot too early, so it now runs directly before its `relativeToGroup` group. Several `before` shortcuts on one key, such as custom editor shortcuts and app shortcuts added next to plugin ones, now run in the order you add them. Pressing Enter on a collapsible column header with column sorting enabled now always collapses it.
